slides.texte_overlay:
habits that help you
think more clearly

a walk without input

walk for twenty minutes with no music or podcast. your mind finally gets space to sort through everything, and clear solutions start to appear on their own.

writing before deciding

before any big decision, write the problem down in one sentence. if you can't, you don't understand it yet, and that's exactly where you should start thinking.

learning one idea a day

spend 5 minutes a day learning one clear idea: a scientific concept, a moment in history, a principle of art. clear inputs make for clear, calm thinking.
slides.texte_sophia:
learning one idea a day

i spend 5 minutes a day on one clear idea: a scientific concept, a moment in history. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and clear inputs made for clearer thinking.

slides.texte_overlay:
one tab at a time

work with a single tab open and close it before opening the next. your attention stops splitting in ten directions, and your thoughts become noticeably sharper.

going to bed earlier

go to bed thirty minutes earlier for a week. clear thinking depends far more on sleep than on any trick, and you'll clearly feel the difference within just a few days.
